goal: Add the project-level loop role catalog (loop.roles in .imm/config.json) with closed capability bases, limits, advisory instructions and diagnostics, resolve it in imm-kernel config --json, and make loop clarify, plan and repair sessions take Host, model, effort and limits from it, per D1 of docs/specs/loop-leader.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-1, BR-DEC-6, BR-DEC-8; meet D1.1-D1.5 in docs/specs/loop-leader.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-role-catalog.test.ts and tests/layered-config.test.ts. Done looks like: loop.roles with a leader role, a planner role on base plan and a security-analyst role on base analyze resolves in imm-kernel config --json under loop.value.roles with base, host, model, effort, when, instructions, limits and source project; an absent loop.roles yields one default role per base on claude-code with limits 40/900/1. Negative: unknown base reports role_base_unknown; an invalid name reports role_name_invalid; instructions ../x.md reports role_instructions_outside_repo; a missing instructions file reports role_instructions_missing; two leader-base roles report leader_role_duplicate; turn_budget 0 reports role_limit_out_of_range, and each rejected role is absent from the catalog. Bound: max_parallel 9 and timeout_s 59 are rejected while max_parallel 8 is accepted; derived-output checks and typecheck pass.

Source BR-DEC-7, BR-DEC-9, BR-DEC-8; meet D1.6-D1.8 in docs/specs/loop-leader.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-role-sessions.test.ts and tests/agent-roles-config.test.ts. Done looks like: loop clarify, plan and repair sessions use the Host, model, effort, turn_budget and timeout_s of their catalog role, and the role instructions file content is appended to the prompt as advisory text without changing permission flags. Negative: an explicit agents.presets.<preset>.roles.plan, clarify or repair binding and a "*" wildcard binding to pi no longer affect loop sessions, and each affected loop role yields one deprecated_config_source diagnostic naming the binding path and loop.roles in .imm/config.json; a configured Host whose binary is absent concludes the session failed with role_host_unavailable and spawns no other Host; read-only argv never contains acceptEdits or --dangerously-skip-permissions. Bound: agents.executor still selects the Lane Host.
